Graphs.Title: Graphs
Graphs.Explain: When a task is broad, Kam starts subagents on its own: explorers and researchers read in parallel, a general agent does a self-contained change. Each task's graph shows them live: what runs at the same time, what each one is doing, and where the main agent picks up their reports. A subagent's risky calls still stop for your approval in the task.
Graphs.Empty.Title: No subagents yet
Graphs.Empty.Body: Ask for something broad, such as "find where settings are read in this project and summarise each place". Kam starts subagents when the work splits well, and they show here while they run.
Graphs.Detail.Hint: Select a subagent to see its brief, its tool calls and the report the main agent received.
Graphs.Detail.StopTip: Stops this subagent. The main agent is told and carries on without its report.
Graphs.Zoom.FitTip: Zooms so every node fits in view
Graphs.Layout.ResetTip: Moves the nodes you dragged back to their places
